high_level_description: This image captures a serene scene of a road during what appears to be either sunrise or sunset, given the soft, warm hues in the sky. The sky transitions from a pale yellow near the horizon to a lighter blue as it extends upward. The road is a multi-lane highway with clear lane markings. A red SUV is prominently featured on the right side of the image, driving along the road. The vehicle is positioned close to the edge of the road, near a black and white striped barrier that runs parallel to the road.
